title: feat(access): Studio permission matrix — field-level bulk + filter (#2600 B4)
body:
## What

**Issue #2600 · B4 (设计迭代 · 字段级批量与搜索)** — expanding an object with many fields (the `field_zoo` pain) meant toggling **two checkboxes per field, one at a time**. The object row already had 读/增改删/全选/清空 shortcuts; the field sub-table had none.

### Changes
- `FieldsSubTable` gains a **field filter** (name/label; appears once an object has > 6 fields) and **全部可读 / 全部可写 / 清空** shortcuts that act over the currently **visible (filtered)** fields — narrow, then bulk-apply.
- New parent `bulkSetFields(object, action, fieldNames)`: `readable` → read-only, `writable` → R+W, `clear` → drops overrides back to the read-only default.
- A `visible / total` count keeps the filter honest.
- Read-only packages still hide the bulk actions (writable-gated); the per-field checkboxes and aria-labels are unchanged.

## Verify (live, showcase backend)
- Expand 客户 (showcase_account, 12 fields) → field **filter** + count `12 / 12` render; typing `name` → `1 / 12`, only the `name` row shows.
- Bulk buttons correctly **absent** on the read-only package (writable-gated).
- Bulk behavior (write-all, filter-scoped read-all, clear-to-default) covered by RTL — the local env has no writable package with objects to exercise the buttons in-browser.

## Tests
New `PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldBulk.test.tsx`: Write-all grants R+W to all fields; filter narrows to `2 / 8` and Read-all revokes write only on the visible subset; Clear reverts to default. Full matrix + Studio guard + Explain suites: **47 tests green**.
